manual.text:
## Specific task description

Task instruction: Grab the white stapler with metal tray and place it on the electronicscale.

Task description: Move the white stapler with a metal support bracket on the left side of the table onto the black weighing surface of the electronic scale to its right, then release it.

Success criteria: Place the stapler on the electronic scale, its body horizontally near the weighing target and at or above weighing-surface height. The left gripper used in this episode must be open and release it.

## Execution tips

- Approach from above and grip straighter middle sides of the stapler's white housing across its width, avoiding rounded ends and thin metal edges to increase pad contact and reduce slipping.
- Open slightly wider than the grasped section and confirm the fingers truly straddle the housing before closing, avoiding pressing only the top or entering the gap between the white lever and metal base.
- During transport, keep the metal scale tray and the lower ends of the fingers above the scale's edges. Make any pose adjustments where there is overhead clearance to avoid catching the tray on the edge or pushing the scale.
- During placement, bring the stapler bottom slowly onto the black weighing surface, avoiding the display and keypad. Confirm support before opening and leave room for fingertip withdrawal to reduce sliding or pushing during release.
